mapping.summary: Documents packaging and checks it against the EU Packaging Regulation, producing conformity declarations.
claims: Packaging types are versioned with full material composition and linked to items and variants
Material classes per Annex II with recycled content per material line
Models sales, grouped and transport packaging layers per item
Calculates weights, empty space ratio and detects composite packaging automatically
Records substance measurements with certificate, lab and date
Checks Articles 5 to 12 including heavy metals, PFAS, recyclability, recycled content, reuse and labelling
Recyclability classes A to E from a maintainable matrix
Risk score with an immutable log of every check
Runs the compliance check automatically when a sales order is released
Generates a versioned Declaration of Conformity per Article 39 and Annex VIII
Produces simplified technical documentation with description and drawing
Packaging datasheets per type and customer as PDF, Excel or web service
Material consumption and shipment reports by role
Assigns manufacturer, importer and distributor roles per customer and item
Covers the conformity side of PPWR rather than EPR fee reporting
